name: Can a clogged drain cause a sewage smell?

mainEntity.name: Can a clogged drain cause a sewage smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a clogged drain can absolutely cause a sewage smell. When hair, soap scum, and other organic matter accumulate in your drain, they begin to decompose. This decomposition process releases gases that smell like sewage. Additionally, a severe clog can slow drainage, allowing standing water to become stagnant and smelly. Clearing the clog is essential to eliminate the odor and restore proper drainage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a clogged drain can cause a sewage smell because decomposing organic matter in the clog releases foul-smelling gases.
